title: Training Note — The Step on a Credit Where Missed Acknowledgements Have Run
content:
# Training Note — The Step on a Credit Where Missed Acknowledgements Have Run

**When is the credit raised for a run of missed acknowledgements?** Where the twelve months to the handling day carry three or more alarms the records show with no acknowledgement and fewer than ten monitored alarms raised in all on the plan under the Building Automation Service Plans, the credit is raised by twenty per cent. Where the twelve months to the handling day carry three or more alarms the records show with no acknowledgement and ten or more monitored alarms raised in all, the credit is raised by ten per cent. In every other case no step at all is taken on the credit.

| Alarms with no acknowledgement in the twelve months | Monitored alarms raised in all in those twelve months | Step on the credit |
|---|---|---|
| 3 or more | fewer than 10 | 20 per cent |
| 3 or more | 10 or more | 10 per cent |
| fewer than 3 | any number | none |

**Which alarms are counted in the first column?** The critical and the urgent alarms alike that the records show with no acknowledgement in the twelve months to the handling day.

**Which alarms are counted in the second column?** Every monitored alarm raised on the plan in those twelve months, acknowledged or not.

**Where does the step act?** On the credit, and on nothing else.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A plan whose alarms credited come to 540.00 USD before the step, showing 4 alarms with no acknowledgement and 8 monitored alarms raised in all, carries the credit raised by 20 per cent, that is 648.00 USD. With 12 monitored alarms raised in all, it would be raised by 10 per cent, that is 594.00 USD.
